title: Oscar and the Promise
author: Wren Whitlock
blurb: Beatrix Dunmore, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
